contentText: If Venezuela proved easier than Iran where Donald Trump's still looking for a win, could that explain why the attention seems to be turning to Cuba? The United States last week dispatching its CIA director to Havana and offering aid, while its crippling blockade plunges the Communist island nation in the dark. We’ll ask about carrots and sticks in the latest in a long, very long list of pressure campaigns.
